correctness.rationale: Each of the 35 vertices and 1211 nonempty faces is enumerated; all 280 free-face pairs are tested at time of deletion. The remaining signed 246-by-336 matrix is independently regenerated and its exact column Hermite normal form has determinant two and full rank; mod-two rank is 245. This proves integral H1=Z/2, H2=Z^90 and vanishing other reduced homology. The graph distance rule, girth six, connectedness and scale-three diameter are checked from BFS. No infinite-size extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The fourth Odd graph is a canonical 35-vertex distance-regular graph at the first unstable radius-two girth boundary (girth six versus general stability threshold seven). Its nontrivial integral two-torsion makes the Rips filtration depend on coefficient characteristic: a mod-two H1 bar extends to radius three and H2 dimension gains one. Neither its rational Betti numbers nor known large-girth graph-power theorems determine this phenomenon. This is a motivated exact finite benchmark, not an arbitrary induced subcomplex or routine parameter tweak.
